g.text: Uptime: 3 years, not counting the false starts
never exits. everything else is a child of it.
daily driver. still argues with me, still wins.
keyboard only, built to survive a Pi
writing its lore first, code comes later.
stopped, not killed. it gets its turn.
new syntax is just a Tuesday
the only thing here with real uptime
holds the password I never remember
passwords in places they had no business being
radio stopped. something else will spawn by spring.
